Search billions of records on Ancestry.com

To obtain copies of a marriage record send $1.00 per record and a self-addressed stamped envelope to:

 

Conway County Clerk
117 South Moose St.  Rm 203

Morrilton, Arkansas 72110-3427

 

Please help our court clerks…provide the book letter, book page and the names of the married couple.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 

Terms used:

“No return” means there is no documentation that the marriage occurred.  The space where the proof was supposed to be recorded is blank.

“Not executed” means the marriage for that particular license did not happen.  The license was returned to the courthouse and hand-written across the face of the license application are the words: “Cancelled.  Not Executed.”

“None” means the person’s age is blank.

“L/D” means license application date.  Provided for marriage records with ‘no return’ and for marriages ‘not executed’.

 

 

Conway County, Arkansas Marriage Record Book Z

19 August 1925 – 28 July 1927

By Groom

 

Note: This book also contained two records from October 1927: (Jones Jr./Matthews), and (Thines/Schneider).

 

Disclaimer:  The handwriting in the first half of this book was sometimes very difficult to decipher.  Accuracy is to the best of my ability.

John Kopp, Conway, Arkansas.

 

Good hunting!

Note #1:  A typed letter dated 11 May 1937 was inserted in front of this marriage record.  It reads:

 

Kansas Children’s Home and Service League

125 West Maple Street

Wichita, Kansas

 

Probate Judge

Morrilton, Arkansas

 

Dear Judge,

            Lloyd Guthrie and Pearl Guthrie have applied to us for a boy whom they wish to take into their home to board.  They state that they were married December 19, 1925.  Will you kindly verify this statement?

 

                                                                                                Helen F. Gant

                                                                                                Supervisor, Wichita Division

 

Note #2:  Someone, probably a researcher, inserted a small handwritten note in front of this marriage record.  It reads: “Thomas Henry and Alberta Theresa”.
